messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: 3xx/5xx spike on /v1/chat.generate route in eu-west-1. Error rate ~18% over 3m, latency + tail. Escalation: oncall.

emma-oncall: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking current routing pins.

raj-sre: seeing lots of 500s with payload mismatch errors in the logs: "model-incompatible: schema-instruct-vs-chat". early hypothesis: model variant mismatch.

lee-runtime: hold on — pulling recent config commits. There's a pin update deployed 09:41 UTC that changed route mapping for `route: /v1/chat.generate` to `model: rwdv2-instruct@20260314` (was rwdv2-chat@20260312).

nina-support: customer reports: "our chat widgets are failing intermittently; users see 'service unavailable'" — large e-comm customer in EU. Impact: degraded UX, increased retries.

carl-customer-success: I just messaged the customer with a brief. They see ~20% failures, some timeouts. They want ETA and mitigation.

emma-oncall: Confirming: chat endpoints routed to an instruct variant -> incompatible schema. That fits the "schema-instruct-vs-chat" errors. Is there an automated fallback in this case?

lee-runtime: Yes. Smart routing tries to fallback to compatible variants by capability set, but because the pinned model is explicitly set at route-level, fallback logic ends up hitting a region-level variant that also advertises 'instruct' interface, causing request <-> variant mismatch and 500s. There's a small routing loop observable: requests bounce between variants and hit the incompatibility.

ops-bot: Deploy 0f3a2e -> production at 2026-03-15T09:41:12Z by ada-platform.

ada-platform: I reviewed the change: intended to pin an instruct model for a batch-inference route but the change included the chat route pattern by mistake (glob "/v1/*generate"). My bad.

emma-oncall: Ok immediate mitigation options: 1) revert the config commit, 2) temporary rule override to remap /v1/chat.generate -> rwdv2-chat@stable, 3) apply a compatibility filter in routing to refuse model variants that don't advertise chat capability (returns 503 instead of 500). Which is fastest?

raj-sre: fastest is a targeted rule override via control plane. Revert needs code review + deploy. I can push a hotfix override if ops gives green.

ada-platform: I can push override in <5m. Doing it now.

ops-bot: control-plane-rule-update: apply override /routes/chat.generate -> rwdv2-chat@stable by ada-platform at 2026-03-15T09:46:03Z.

emma-oncall: Applying traffic-watch and rolling tests.

lee-runtime: After override, error rate dropped from 18% -> 2% within 2 minutes. Latency normalized. Root cause confirmed: wrong route pin.

nina-support: Notifying impacted customer with mitigation note. ETA to full resolution?

carl-customer-success: I've told them we rolled back the bad mapping and are monitoring; asked if they want postmortem. They requested a follow-up and SLA credit evaluation.

emma-oncall: Incident status: mitigated. Still monitoring for regressions. Next steps: revert the accidental commit, add CI lint to prevent route glob mistakes, add runtime guard for variant capability mismatch.

ada-platform: I opened PR #4127 to tighten route selector granularity and removed the global glob. PR description explains accidental overlap.

raj-sre: Also opening an immediate follow-up: create a routing-guard that will refuse to pin an 'instruct' variant against a route that declares 'chat' schema. Ticket created: RT-8732.

lee-runtime: I'll prepare a small patch to make fallback return 503 with clear error when variant capability mismatch detected, so we avoid 500s and opaque loops. Will target canary tomorrow.

emma-oncall: Action items assigned: ada -> revert/PR (in progress). raj -> create RT-8732 & follow up on rule enforcement. lee -> change fallback behavior. nina/carl -> customer comms + SLA evaluation. I'll escalate to infra ops lead if we see any residual.

ops-bot: incident-bot: incident severity lowered to Sev2 (was Sev1) at 2026-03-15T09:52:40Z.

carl-customer-success: Customer acknowledged and said recovery looks good; they will wait for postmortem.

emma-oncall: Handoff notes for next oncall (if any): time window to watch = 2h, key metric = /v1/chat.generate 5xx rate in eu-west-1, pinned-model map, recent config audit. If any regressions, escalate to eng-runtime.

ada-platform: PR merged and deploy scheduled. I added a post-deploy check: `redwoodctl audit routes --since=1h --filter="pin:instruct AND route:chat"` which will alert to mis-pins.

lee-runtime: Created draft postmortem doc in /incidents/postmortems/RT-8732-draft.md with root cause, timeline, and action items.

emma-oncall: Closing timeline: first alert 2026-03-15T09:43Z, override applied 09:46Z, error rate normal by 09:48Z. Customer notified 09:55Z.

nina-support: I'll schedule the post-incident call with customer at 15:00 UTC.

emma-oncall: Thanks team. If anyone wants to add notes to the postmortem, put them in the doc.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived.
